objective: Test whether pre-positioning a price-improving Bybit maker order before an externally predicted Binance Futures displacement can materially change queue priority and create repeatable after-cost utility above the current 24bp rank-one growth benchmark.

economic_thesis.problem_repaired: The reported reactive cross-venue maker route entered behind the displayed best-quote queue after the shock and filled only after edge decay.
economic_thesis.material_change: This route scores and places a new inside-spread best quote before the displacement, so modeled initial queue ahead is zero rather than the historical displayed best queue.
economic_thesis.label: Direct realized gross basis-point utility of LONG, SHORT or implicit FLAT. No-placement and structurally canceled unfilled orders receive zero. Filled orders receive structural target/stop return after exit latency.
economic_thesis.growth_path: One dense 500ms decision clock and direct cost-adjusted action selection can accumulate many small independent utilities without leverage rescue.

market_scope.same_time_long_short_actions: one action selected only by predicted utility after global chronological arbitration

source_contract.provider: Tardis normalized downloadable CSV public first-day samples

decision_state.clock: every completed 500ms, built only from completed 100ms local-arrival buckets
decision_state.pre_shock_condition: absolute completed Binance 500ms return at most 3bp
decision_state.basis: prior-only shifted 10-minute EWM of log Bybit/Binance executable mids
decision_state.structural_range: prior-only shifted five-minute rolling high/low of Binance fair value expressed on Bybit
decision_state.spread_condition: Bybit spread at least two ticks at signal; post-only activation still requires strict non-crossing after latency

execution_contract.signal_availability: completed signal bucket plus one full 100ms boundary before latency bins
execution_contract.activation_quote: last known Bybit BBO immediately before activation
execution_contract.post_only: order must remain strictly inside the activation BBO
execution_contract.modeled_order_size: 5% of the activation-side displayed best-quote amount
execution_contract.counterfactual_fill: Because the order improves the best price, later opposite aggressor amount is credited only while the historical same-side best is not better than our order; historical cross-through fills immediately. No cancellation-ahead credit exists.
execution_contract.pending_cancel: prior external-liquidity target or opposite-liquidity stop is reached before fill
execution_contract.filled_exit: opposite-liquidity stop first, otherwise external-liquidity target; completed state plus 100ms exit latency
execution_contract.one_global_slot: pending and filled states occupy the slot from actual placement until structural release

features: side-signed Binance and Bybit quote imbalance
side-signed Binance and Bybit microprice edge
Bybit spread in ticks and relative spread
Binance and Bybit one-second quote-update intensity
frozen target and stop distances and ratio

model.target: direct gross utility in basis points including zeros for no placement and unfilled cancellation
model.calibration: one monotone isotonic map on the calibration date only

account_contract.authorization: calibrated predicted gross utility at least selected cost plus 2bp
account_contract.winner_removal: remove the largest positive 10% accepted event keys before complete global-slot rerouting
account_contract.funding: not opened in the initial one-day fatal screen; any survivor requires actual Bybit funding before ranking

combined_decision.advance: Both 100ms and 300ms paths pass every frozen gate, then expand the exact model and mechanism across additional pre-2024 dates and add actual funding before ranking.
combined_decision.retire: Either path fails after adequate samples or direct utility remains sub-cost/concentrated. Do not tune spread, pre-shock threshold, tick improvement, participation, latency, model, target, stop, risk or leverage.
